name: pumpkin-wisps
description: A one-shot effect for a limited pumpkin king outfit: three small teal-green ghost flames (will-o'-the-wisps) lift off the character's shoulders and hands, drift upward with a gentle sway, flicker once and fade out after about one second. Pixel art at exactly the sprite's own pixel size, each flame only a few pixels tall, solid flame shapes in two or three teal-greens with one pale core pixel and a thick dark outline, crisp hard pixels, no soft glow, no halo, no smoke. The character itself does not change.
